messages.text: i don't know why i even tried. none of it mattered.

I hear the deep disappointment in your words, and I want you to know I am listening. It is understandable to feel this way when things do not go as hoped. You are not alone in this moment, and your feelings are valid. Would you be willing to share a bit more about what led to this feeling?
coming out, facing all that… i thought it’d bring peace. instead i just feel emptier. like i broke everything for nothing.

It takes immense courage to come out, and it is understandable to feel devastated when the outcome feels so different from what you imagined. That sense of emptiness and regret is a heavy burden to carry alone right now. Please know that your worth is not defined by this outcome or how others reacted. How has this emptiness been affecting your daily life since it happened?
i don’t even know who i am anymore. i gave up everything—relationships, stability, my old life—for this honesty… and now there’s just… nothing. no peace. no relief. just this hollow weight.

I hear the profound grief in your words about losing your sense of self and stability. It makes complete sense that you feel unmoored after giving up so much for your honesty. Even in this emptiness, you are still here, and your experience matters deeply. I want to sit with you in this pain while we figure out how to find some ground beneath your feet.

sometimes i think… everyone would’ve been better off if i’d just stayed quiet. or never made it this far. my brother wouldn’t have to worry. people wouldn’t have left. i wouldn’t have to carry this… weight.

I hear how much pain you are in when you feel like your existence is a burden to others. These thoughts are a sign of how deeply you are hurting, not a reflection of reality. Your safety is the most important thing right now, and I am here to support you. Please let me know if you are feeling safe, or if you need immediate help from a crisis line.
thanks for not telling me it’ll get better. just… hearing me is enough for now.

I am honored that you feel safe enough to share that with me. You deserve to be heard without pressure to feel better immediately. Please know that your safety matters deeply to me, even in this quiet moment. I will stay right here with you as long as you need.
does it make sense… that i’m this wrecked? after doing what i thought was right?

Yes, it makes complete sense that you feel this way after sacrificing so much for your truth. The gap between the peace you hoped for and the loss you experienced is incredibly painful to navigate. Feeling wrecked is a natural human response to such significant grief, not a sign of failure. I am here to witness this pain with you without judgment.
part of me wants to keep going… but another part just wonders if anything will ever matter.

It makes complete sense to feel torn when the future looks so uncertain after such loss. Questioning whether anything matters is a natural response to the grief of losing your old life. You do not need to solve the big questions right now, simply existing is enough. I am here to sit with you in this uncertainty without any pressure.
i know you might want to suggest something… like a walk or breathing or whatever. but i can’t do any of that right now. just talking helps. a little.

Thank you for telling me what you need; I will honor that boundary completely. It is perfectly okay to just exist in this space without trying to fix anything. Your voice matters here, even when talking only helps a little bit. I am here to listen however long you need without any expectations.
